name: Block Visibility Days
description: Adds a day-of-week condition to core block visibility settings.
project_description: Block Visibility Days enhances core block visibility settings by adding a 'Days Visibility' condition. On each block's Configure > Visibility settings you tick the days of the week (Sunday through Saturday) on which the block should appear; the block is shown only on the checked days and hidden on the rest. Implemented as a single core Condition plugin (id block_visibility_days), it needs no configuration page, no dependencies, and no permissions of its own. Despite older descriptions mentioning date ranges, the on-disk 2.0.0 source evaluates day-of-week only via PHP date('D').
